description: Defines a class 'SessionClosedStatusReport' that encapsulates information about a closed AMQP session, including session details and failure reasons.

classes.name: SessionClosedStatusReport
classes.description: Represents a report indicating that an AMQP session has been closed, including details about the session and failure reason.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of SessionClosedStatusReport with specified failure and session.

methods.name: getFailure
methods.description: Returns the ConnectionFailure associated with the closed session.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Returns the JMS Session object associated with the report.
